explication: This repository is primarily a collection of proxy-client configurations and routing rules, not a running application. Its README frames the material as video-demo rules and recommends adapting it for individual use. The principal workflow is an operator choosing a client/version configuration, using its proxy and routing policy, and optionally referring to the Mihomo smart-model training code. Most configuration files were not sampled, so links between configs, rules, and client behavior are left undocumented rather than inferred.
